frozen_before: first candidate evaluation on these cases
cohort: 36 queries, 42 fictional conversations, 6 domains, English and Chinese
selection: all cases; no answer-based or post-result filtering
authorship: New hand-authored fictional conversations; not generated from long_data.py templates. Identical intake questions deliberately check project isolation.
reuse_policy: After first scoring this is regression data. Do not tune on its outcomes and call the rerun heldout.
limits: Small synthetic stress set authored by the same assistant team, not a population sample or independent human annotation.
Short conversations and known evidence labels do not establish large-archive or real-user generalization.
Source-evidence retrieval only; no generated-answer quality is inferred.
